panels.name: ICU Transfer Labs
panels.preview: Transfer: WBC 7.2 (eos 2%), lactate 1.0, Cr 1.2, bili 4.6, INR 1.7, plt 95, ammonia 45.

panels.name: Recovery Labs (after antibiotic cessation)
panels.preview: Improving across the board after antibiotics stopped: WBC normalized (7.8), lactate cleared, bilirubin and INR improving, creatinine recovering, off vasopressors. Cultures (final) all no growth.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs — Continued Recovery
panels.preview: Recovering: WBC 8.7, eos 4%, lactate 1.2, Cr 1.6, bili 6.5, INR 2.0, plt 74. Fungal cultures final no growth.

panels.name: Labs Resumed — Unexpected Clinical Improvement
panels.preview: Off antibiotics/pressors ~36 h and improving: WBC 9.6, eos 6%, lactate 1.6, Cr 1.9, bili 7.8, INR 2.2.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD19 — Day of Goals-of-Care Transition
panels.preview: Last labs before comfort measures: WBC 11.3, eos 9%, lactate 2.7, bili 9.6, INR 2.6, Cr 2.5 (MELD ~40).

panels.name: ICU Labs — Persistent Fevers / Worsening (Day ~16)
panels.preview: Worsening: bilirubin 9.5, INR 2.6, Cr 2.4, Na 134 → MELD ~40. WBC 11.0, lactate mildly up. Blood cultures x multiple sets NO GROWTH; procalcitonin 0.3 (within range). Eosinophils 7%. Fevers ongoing.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD15 — Fungal Studies Negative
panels.preview: HD15: all cultures final no growth; beta-D-glucan negative; PCT 0.30. WBC 11.1, eos 8%. Bili 9.3, INR 2.6, Cr 2.4.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD13 — ID Consult; Fungal Studies Sent
panels.preview: ID consult day: WBC 11.4 flat, eos 8%. CSF/ascitic/blood cultures all no growth. Fungal cultures + beta-D-glucan sent. Bili 9.0, INR 2.6, Cr 2.4. Vanc trough 18.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD11 — Broad Source Workup (CSF, Repeat Ascites)
panels.preview: Broad workup day: normal CSF, repeat ascites negative for SBP, all blood cultures negative, PCT 0.31. WBC 11.2 (not rising), eos 7%. Bili 8.4, INR 2.5, Cr 2.3.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD9
panels.preview: HD9: WBC 11.7 (falling despite fevers), eos 4%, lactate 2.5, Cr 2.1, bili 7.3, INR 2.4, ammonia 88. 5/7 cultures no growth at 72 h; PCT 0.30.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD7 — Persistent Fevers
panels.preview: HD7: WBC 12.4, eos 3%, Cr 2.0, bili 6.6, INR 2.3, lactate 2.3. Vanc trough 17. 5/4 blood cultures final no growth; 5/7 sets pending.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD5
panels.preview: HD5: WBC 13.1 (plateau), eos 2%, lactate 2.4, Cr 1.8, bili 5.9. Blood cultures no growth at 48 h; urine culture final negative; PCT 0.36.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD4 — On Norepinephrine; Repeat Paracentesis
panels.preview: Still febrile on norepinephrine: WBC 13.9, lactate 3.1, Cr 1.7. Repeat paracentesis negative for SBP (42 PMN). Cultures no growth at 24 h.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD3 — New Fevers; Cultures Drawn
panels.preview: First febrile day: WBC 13.6 (ANC 10.9, bands 5%), lactate 2.9, procalcitonin 0.42 (within range). Blood/urine cultures sent; UA bland. Eos 1%.

panels.name: MICU AM Labs HD2 — Post-TIPS
panels.preview: Hgb stable 8.7 post-transfusion, lactate cleared to 1.9, bilirubin 5.0 (up post-TIPS), ammonia 82, Cr 1.5.

panels.name: Post-Transfusion / Post-TIPS Labs (evening of admission)
panels.preview: After MTP and TIPS: Hgb 8.4, plt 74, INR 2.0, fibrinogen 160, lactate 3.4 (resuscitating), BUN 34 with the bleed. WBC 14.2 with left shift.

panels.name: Admission Labs
panels.preview: WBC 12.0, Hgb 8.6, Plt 80. Na 132, Cr 1.4 (baseline unknown). Tbili 4.2, AST 50, ALT 60, INR 1.9. MELD-Na ~25 at admission. (Paracentesis: 86 PMN, no organisms — negative for SBP.)

panels.name: Outpatient Weight-Loss Workup Labs
panels.preview: Initial outpatient evaluation of weight loss: mild anemia (Hgb 10.8), normal TSH, AFP mildly elevated (18, nonspecific in cirrhosis), HbA1c normal. Liver imaging pending at the time of acute presentation.
